title: fetch_session URL construction missing slash for non-root origins
description: fetch_session builds the session URL with: format\!("{}.well-known/jmap", self.base_url). The comment claims url::Url::Display always ends with a trailing slash for origin URLs, but this is only true when the URL has no explicit path. url::Url for 'http://host:8080' displays as 'http://host:8080/' (with slash) so the claim is correct for that case. However, the constructor rejects URLs with a path other than '/', so the only stored URL shape is the root form — making this safe in practice. The real risk is the fragility of the invariant: it is not type-enforced, only enforced by the constructor guard, and the comment is the only documentation. If the constructor guard is ever relaxed or bypassed (e.g. in tests), the format string silently produces 'http://host/.well-known/jmap' → correct, but 'http://host/api.well-known/jmap' → wrong. File this as a latent brittleness: the URL assembly should use url::Url::join rather than string formatting to make it robust by construction.
